summary: Bilibili Inc., a PRC-incorporated foreign private issuer listed in Hong Kong (09626) and the US, furnished a Form 6-K attaching its monthly return to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong for the month ended October 31, 2026, covering movements in authorized and issued share capital. No transaction was announced. Authorized capital is unchanged: 100,000,000 Class Y, 9,800,000,000 Class Z and 100,000,000 undesignated shares at US$0.0001 par, totaling US$1,000,000. Issued Class Z rose by 3,052 shares to 340,437,788; Class Y held at 79,700,010; the filer confirms compliance with the 25% minimum public float. This is a routine HKEX equity-issuer disclosure with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
